input.content:
# Research Plan: 2007 Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Inductee with Longest-Charting Billboard Hot 100 Song (pre-Jan 2024)

## Goal
Identify which 2007 Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductee had the longest-charting song on the Billboard Hot 100 prior to January 2024, and name both the artist and song.

## Components
1. **List all 2007 inductees** (performers category, possibly early influencers/sidemen)
2. **For each inductee, find their Billboard Hot 100 chart history** - specifically the song with the most weeks on the chart
3. **Compare chart durations** across all inductees' longest-charting songs
4. **Verify the winner** with authoritative Billboard data (pre-Jan 2024 cutoff)

## Constraints
- Only consider chart performance prior to January 2024
- Use Billboard Hot 100 (not other charts like Hot 100 Airplay, etc.)
- Focus on "weeks on chart" as the metric for "longest-charting"
- Cite authoritative sources (Billboard.com, official chart archives, reputable music databases)

## Queries

### High Depth
1. **2007 Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductees list** - Complete list of performers inducted in 2007
2. **Billboard Hot 100 chart records for each 2007 inductee** - Weeks on chart for each artist's songs

### Medium Depth
3. **Grandmaster Flash & the Furious Five Billboard Hot 100 history** - Longest charting song
4. **The Ronettes Billboard Hot 100 history** - Longest charting song
5. **Patti Smith Billboard Hot 100 history** - Longest charting song

### Medium Depth (continued)
6. **Van Halen Billboard Hot 100 history** - Longest charting song
7. **R.E.M. Billboard Hot 100 history** - Longest charting song

### Low Depth
8. **Early influencers/sidemen 2007 inductees** - Check if any had Hot 100 entries (The Ventures, etc.)

Now I have complete data for all five 2007 inductees. Let me compile the findings:

## Summary of Longest-Charting Songs by 2007 Inductees

| Inductee | Longest-Charting Song | Weeks on Hot 100 (pre-Jan 2024) |
|----------|----------------------|----------------------------------|
| Grandmaster Flash & the Furious Five | "The Message" | 7 weeks |
| **The Ronettes** | **"Sleigh Ride"** | **~30–35 weeks** (39 total through 2025-26) |
| Patti Smith | "Because the Night" | 18 weeks |
| Van Halen | "Jump" | 21 weeks |
| R.E.M. | "Losing My Religion" | 21 weeks |

**The Ronettes' "Sleigh Ride" is the clear winner.** Even by the January 2024 cutoff, it had accumulated approximately 30–35 weeks on the Hot 100 (first entering December 2018, re-entering each holiday season, peaking at #8 on December 23, 2023), far exceeding the next closest at 21 weeks.

## Sources

1. **2007 Inductee List** — Rock & Roll Hall of Fame official site & Wikipedia: https://rockhall.com/inductees/classes/2007 / https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Rock_and_Roll_Hall_of_Fame_inductees
2. **Grandmaster Flash & the Furious Five — "The Message" (7 weeks)** — Music Charts Archive: http://musicchartsarchive.com/singles/grandmaster-flash-and-the-furious-five/the-message
3. **The Ronettes — "Sleigh Ride" (39 weeks total, ~30–35 by Jan 2024)** — ELPEE.jp Billboard Database: https://elpee.jp/artist/The%20Ronettes / https://elpee.jp/single/Sleigh%20Ride/The%20Ronettes/
4. **Patti Smith — "Because the Night" (18 weeks)** — Music Charts Archive: https://musicchartsarchive.com/singles/patti-smith/because-the-night
5. **Van Halen — "Jump" (21 weeks)** — ELPEE.jp Billboard Database: https://elpee.jp/single/Jump/Van%20Halen
6. **R.E.M. — "Losing My Religion" (21 weeks)** — ELPEE.jp Billboard Database: https://elpee.jp/artist/R.E.M.
